one_line: Warrior-king of Tripura whose power reached into the Bengal frontier in the late 15th–early 16th century.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to early 40s, medium-tall, athletic but not bulky, with the poised bearing of a seasoned commander.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, medium-brown complexion, straight nose, neatly groomed medium-thick moustache with a short trimmed goatee, sharp dark eyes under slightly arched brows, default expression calm and alert with a subtle, confident half-smile.
appearance.hair: Long straight black hair oiled smooth, pulled back and knotted into a low bun at the back of the head; he wears a narrow gold-embroidered cloth band (simple mukut-style headband) in deep red wrapped around the forehead with a small central leaf-shaped gold ornament.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length white cotton angarkha-style tunic with a slight overlap closing to the right, edged with a narrow deep-red border and tiny gold thread motifs, over a fitted sleeveless quilted cotton coat (light armour) in muted indigo with vertical stitching; around his waist is a broad red silk patka (sash) with thin gold stripes tied slightly to the left with the loose end hanging to mid-thigh, and beneath he has slim straight churidar-style trousers in soft off-white; over one shoulder and across the chest is a simple steel-bossed round leather shield slung on a brown strap; on his feet are brown leather mojari-style shoes with modest upturned toes; jewellery is restrained—a single thin gold chain, a pair of small gold hoop earrings, and a plain gold bangle on his right wrist—conveying royalty but practical for campaign; the overall look is that of a late medieval northeastern Indian king prepared for both court and battlefield.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved single-edged talwar-like sword with a steel blade, a simple iron hilt with a modest disc pommel, and a plain dark-brown leather scabbard hanging from a brown leather belt over his red sash, which he habitually rests his right hand upon.

ref_desc: Dhanya Manikya is a medium-brown, sharp-eyed king in his late 30s with a moustache and short goatee, long black hair in a low bun, a red gold-embroidered headband, white angarkha over indigo quilted coat, red sash, off-white trousers, brown mojari shoes, a slung round shield, and a simple curved talwar in a brown scabbard, all in deep red, white, indigo, brown and gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Dhanya Manikya, a late-medieval Tripura warrior-king: medium-tall and athletic, medium-brown skin, oval face with high cheekbones, neatly groomed moustache and short goatee, sharp dark eyes with a calm, confident expression. His long straight black hair is oiled smooth and tied into a low bun, and he wears a narrow deep-red headband like a simple mukut with a small central leaf-shaped gold ornament on his forehead. Dress him in a knee-length white cotton angarkha-style tunic with a slight right-side overlap and a narrow deep-red border with tiny gold thread motifs, over a sleeveless indigo quilted cotton coat with vertical stitching that fits close to his torso. Tie a broad red silk patka sash with thin gold stripes around his waist, knot slightly to the left with the end hanging to mid-thigh, and give him slim straight off-white churidar-style trousers. Across one shoulder and chest hangs a round leather shield with a few steel bosses on a brown strap. On his feet are brown leather mojari shoes with modest upturned toes. Add minimal royal jewellery: a thin gold chain, small gold hoop earrings, and a plain gold bangle on his right wrist. His signature weapon is a slightly curved single-edged talwar with a plain iron hilt and disc pommel, in a dark-brown leather scabbard hanging from a brown belt over the red sash; show his right hand resting naturally on the hilt. Use a deep red, white, indigo blue, brown leather, and gold colour palette, and present him from head to toe clearly so the costume, hair, face, shield, and sword can be consistently redrawn.
